data.title: 112 Teams Await the 2026-27 Copa del Rey Draw - Yahoo Sports
data.content: The first-round draw for the 2026-27 Copa del Rey takes place on Monday 5 October at 13:00 CEST, with 112 teams set to discover their opening opponents. SPORT reports that 116 clubs are involved in the edition overall, with FC Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atlético de Madrid and Real Sociedad entering at the round of 32 because of their participation in the Spanish Super Cup. The first-round draw includes 16 teams from Primera División and 22 from Segunda División, alongside clubs from lower categories. The 112-team draw field is not the full tournament entry: the four Super Cup participants are excluded at this stage and join at the round of 32, bringing the edition's total to 116. Teams from lower divisions are paired with opponents from higher categories, while geographical proximity is taken into account when the ties are formed. Real Racing are among the Primera División clubs in the draw.
